title: Lusine - Without a Plan
direction: Use moderate repeating cluster shapes, but vary their spacing and location. Let section changes alter density more than force. Keep enough silence for the ripple interference to read.

sections.name: motif: opening
sections.note: Recurring cluster gestures move and change spacing without a beat grid. Measured note patterns carry the main surface; incidental weather is held behind them.
